name: AgentGym (Unified LLM Agent Framework)
description: AgentGym is a unified framework providing 14 diverse interactive environments across 7 real-world scenario categories including web navigation with dynamic sites, text games, household and embodied tasks, digital games, tool-use, programming, and deep search. It supports real-time concurrent multi-turn interaction in ReAct-style format and is designed for LLM-based agents with support for self-improvement via accumulated experience and cross-task evolution. AgentGym-RL extends it with reinforcement learning on top of LLM policies.
reputation: Emerging unified framework explicitly designed for LLM agent evaluation and self-improvement; cited as a dynamic successor to static benchmarks; covers the broadest range of real-world agentic scenarios in a single framework.
notes: 14 environments spanning 7 categories. Designed for self-improvement — agents accumulate experience across tasks. Real-time concurrent interaction distinguishes it from offline QA benchmarks. AgentGym-RL enables RL fine-tuning on LLM policies. Supports direct comparison of algorithmic agents, LLMs, and humans via similar interfaces.
